speaker: Doctor
text:
Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with rapid breathing, liver enlargement, and pitting edema; how old are you, and have you noticed any swelling in your legs or shortness of breath when you lie down?

REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count, Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel, Liver_Function_Tests.
REQUEST IMAGES: Abdominal_Ultrasound, Chest_XRay.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: WBC 11,000 /μL, Hemoglobin 12 g/dL, Platelets 300,000 /μL; Liver_Function_Tests: ALT 45 U/L, AST 47 U/L, Albumin 4.0 g/dL, Total_Bilirubin 0.8 mg/dL; Comprehensive_Metabolic_Panel: NORMAL READINGS; Abdominal_Ultrasound: NORMAL READINGS; Chest_XRay: Enlarged cardiac silhouette, no pulmonary edema.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The blood work and ultrasound are reassuring, but the chest X-ray showing an enlarged heart with clear lungs is very concerning. Given your rapid breathing and leg swelling, have you noticed any fatigue, pale skin, or a history of congenital heart defects?

REQUEST TEST: Electrocardiogram (ECG), Echocardiogram.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Electrocardiogram: NORMAL READINGS; Echocardiogram: Presence of an atrial septal defect with left to right shunt.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Atrial Septal Defect with Heart Failure.
